t: JCSP - Wikipedia
s: January 6, 2026 - JCSP is an implementation of communicating sequential processes (CSP) for the programming language Java. Although CSP is a mathematical system, JCSP does not require in-depth mathematical skill, allowing instead that programmers can achieve well-behaved software by following simple rules.
